title: The Last Promise Again
author: Marguerite Crane
blurb: Mirabel Quintana, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
